releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.5 — Pure Telegram-Style Click Flow, Inline Reactions & Clean Header
releaseNotes:
• Pure Telegram-Style Message Click: Non-intrusive anchored action menu directly at the bubble with transparent dismiss layer, preserving uninterrupted conversation flow.
• Inline Reactions Inside Bubble: Applied reaction badges now sit cleanly inside the message container beneath the message content.
• Streamlined Action Menu: Removed duplicate 'Select' action (multi-selection handled via continuous tapping/long-press).
• Clean Username: Blue verified tick badge removed from user header.
• 120Hz Dynamic UI: Dynamic Island call pill, elastic swipe-to-reply, consecutive adaptive bubble morphing & kinetic photo lightbox.
